test_title: PYST 66: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statement:**

Some bins are tins.

All tins are pins.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some bins are pins.

(II): All pins are tins.
solution:
**Statements:**

Some bins are tins.

All tins are pins.

**Venn Diagram Logic:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5428bf728d412b04d2d11d3851cc5d6f649b1297cecbc89f902d0e77d12cdd9.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some bins are pins: **Follows (**Because some bins are tins and all tins are pins.)

(II) All pins are tins: **Does not follows (**Because only “All tins are pins” is given, not the reverse.)

Therefore, only conclusion (I) follows.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".**
